abort.already_configured: A controller for this base topic already exists.

user.title: Alpha2MQTT battery controller
user.description: The controller holds grid power near a target by choosing dispatch watts. The policy entity decides what is allowed.

data.state_topic: State topic (Alpha2MQTT/state/second/ten before the fast firmware)
data.policy_entity: Policy sensor (state charge, discharge, hold or normal; attribute soc_target; optional grid_offset, fixed true with watts, both true with other_soc)
data.grid_scale_entity: Grid clamp scale entity (overrides the scale)
data.correction_entity: Correction entity: W added to the scaled clamp, or with estimate the house load less solar; optional attributes west and east, solar in W, for the solar feed forward, seq of the fast message it was rendered from, age_s of its oldest input, and west_fallback true when West is the 10 s value
data.log_dir: Step log directory (empty for alpha2mqtt_controller in the config directory)
data.log_entities: Entities to log (each change goes in the step log)
